error_busy: You can't use the tablet right now
no_apps_text: Jobs and city services add their apps here when you have access: get a job, visit City Hall or meet the right people.
app_unavailable_text: The app stopped responding. It may be restarting; try again in a moment.
wallpaper_note: The same wallpaper is used on the lock screen and the home screen.
picture_note: Saved only on this computer. Nobody else sees it, and it is never sent to the server.
picture_bad: That link doesn't work. Paste a direct https link to a picture (ending in .png, .jpg, .webp, ...).
icon_note: Clear and Tinted let the wallpaper show through the icons.
show_widgets: Show widgets next to the apps
dock_note: Up to %s apps fit in the dock.
notifications_hidden_note: Hidden apps never show their notifications on the lock screen.
appearance_note: Light and dark change the apps, widgets, dock and notifications. The wallpaper stays the same.
code_note: Police can search your tablet. Hidden apps stay off the home screen, the dock and notifications, and only you can open them.
name: Name
serial_note: The serial number is the tablet item's serial: a stolen tablet can be traced back to its owner.
